subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A science fair displayed a 3D-printed hand made for a child who had lost fingers.”?
options: The design looked simple and strange, but students were interested.
What began as a simple game became a science activity.
Mark bought a snow globe at a second-hand shop.
The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The design looked simple and strange, but students were interested.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「What began as a simple game became a science activity.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Mark bought a snow globe at a second-hand shop.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.」，答案為「The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
